review_notes: The margin's literal glosses (in strength; strengtheneth might) were read and set aside under rule 38; the printed text's is strong is what is aligned, and it fuses preposition and noun.
The competing reading would give is to the preposition alone and mark עֹז unrepresented, which rule 30 forbids where one English word carries both.
